hooks.name: Form label check on save
hooks.description: When an .html or .tsx file under bank/, fixtures/haunted_bank/ or dashboard/src/ is saved, scan that one file for form fields with no label (backend/scan_file.py). Shell command only: it never calls a model. Prints nothing when the file is clean or out of scope, so unrelated saves add nothing to the context. Never changes code. Windows: replace python3 with py -3.
